name: Gose (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Gose city emblem in white: a ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised letter V.
history: Municipal flag of Gose, a city in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 November 1978; the emblem dates from 31 March 1958.

features.role: Gose city emblem — a ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised letter V
